sentences.en: The Party won a sweeping victory at the general election.
sentences.zh: 1. 在大选中，该党赢得了压倒性的胜利。

sentences.en: You sweep the kitchen floor while I clean the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 2. 你打扫厨房地板，我来清理浴室。

sentences.en: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
sentences.zh: 3. 北方的春天刮起强风，把道路上的尘土一扫而空。
